scope: Serial C++ whole-checkpoint selected-load timing publication and repair, with independent native graph and DCP verification

observations.required: Exactly one setup and one hold observation for every frozen load; all selected nets represented; the same keys and coverage class in baseline and candidate
observations.missing: Never a zero slack, never accepted
observations.unconstrained: Rejected by default; an explicit policy may preserve reported unconstrained coverage without claiming timing constraints were met there
observations.path_changes: Worst through-load paths may change startpoint/end/corner; observed slack is evaluated directly, not converted to an isolated additive PIP delay budget

binding.context: SHA256 of verified original DCP, cohort, logical/physical mapping, query source and load set identities
binding.trees: Exact canonical complete selected-tree serialization, including node, parent, PIP direction key and depth; no lossy hash used inside C++
binding.epoch: Candidate oracle must equal current authority epoch plus one; exhaustion and replay reject
binding.producer_boundary: Python verifies frozen manifest/input/artifact digests and exact DCP-to-tree lineage before converting native observations. Raw C++ CLI input is not a cryptographic attestation of a Vivado run.

publication.baseline: Must already satisfy the selected policy; otherwise construction fails
publication.candidate: Complete independently checked shared trees and ownership, with current full-candidate timing oracle
publication.accept: Allocate the complete candidate and oracle before swapping serial authority and advancing epoch
publication.reject: No change to authority trees, ownership, history, resource versions or timing epoch
publication.resource_versions: This is whole-checkpoint epoch publication. Imported resource history/versions belong to that checkpoint; consumers must invalidate all old views on epoch change and cannot compare resource versions across checkpoint epochs alone.
publication.concurrency: No concurrent borrowers or workers during publication; distributed/native shadow publication is not implemented by this controller

repair.seed: Whole physical nets with finite setup/hold slack below the explicit policy floor
repair.closure: If an original tree would occupy another proposed net's resource, recursively restore that net too; at worst the entire selected baseline is restored and reported explicitly
repair.mutation: Private proposal copy only; rip up restored nets, retain roots, then insert original directed tree PIPs in increasing depth
repair.metadata: History remains unchanged and every nonroot owner removal/addition increments that resource's private version once; overflow rejects without changing inputs
repair.acceptance: Every repair needs new full-candidate native timing, even if individual original net delays are known; old timing cannot be attached to changed trees

policy_status: Development ablations on the declared 70-net cohort. Positive margin floors are experimental choices, not user requirements, universal FPGA rules or held-out tuned defaults.
not_proven: native SLL corridor and distributed shadow integration
